description: 16-bit dense GEMM: out = a @ b.T + bias (b is (n, k) when trans_b, else (k, n)). Covers aiter tuned_gemm / gemm_a16w16, hipBLASLt and Triton dense projections.

m.doc: tokens in this call; the only axis that varies across a task's cases

layout.doc: b_preshuffled_16x16 is aiter shuffle_weight(b, (16, 16)), the bpreshuffle asm/CK path

hooks.preshuffle_16x16: (t, name, sym) -> t stored the way the served dispatcher reads it: aiter.ops.shuffle.shuffle_weight(t, layout=(16, 16)), then set t.is_shuffled = True. Use the installed function, never a re-implementation.

call: Invoke the live entry with the exact keyword names of the inspected signature; return out only. Do not pass a preallocated `out` unless the deployed caller does.

timing.cache: b has lifetime weight: in serving it is evicted by the other layers' weights between calls, so the harness read-evict before each sample matches it; a reads warm in deployment and cold here — say so when a decode bucket is bandwidth bound on a.
notes: n and k are module-level constants of one task: a second (n, k) is a sibling task directory, not another case

negative_controls: drop the last K tile of the accumulation (loop bound k - BLOCK_K): the error is ~|a_k||b_k| per element, orders above the dot_product bound
swap two output columns' store offsets: an exact permutation the bound rejects at multiple >> 10
pitfalls: Operands must be unit variance (a ~ N(0,1), b ~ N(0,1/k)); a ~ U(0,1) makes every output ~k/4 and a K-tile bug vanishes into the relative error.

aiter tuned GEMM dispatch is keyed on (M, N, K) in a CSV and decode M is looked up by its padded tier; a miss silently takes the heuristic kernel. Record which kernel each case actually ran (AITER_LOG_TUNED_CONFIG) rather than inferring it.
AITER_CONFIG_* replaces the whole tuned table rather than merging: an A/B that sets it for one arm changes every other shape too.
A decode o_proj hot shape may run a Triton kernel while the meta language field says asm: the language belongs to the shape, not the op.
hipBLASLt / tuned GEMMs may split K: the bound already allows max_split_k = 16; do not loosen it further without a measured baseline violation.
